title: Internal error with generic type and alias using import *
body:
Dang, I'm on a bug roll today. :D

In `x.py`:

``` python
from y import *

notes = None  # type: G[X]
# Using the new annotation syntax `notes: G[X]` can also reproduce the crash.
```

`y.py`:

``` python
from typing import Generic, TypeVar

T = TypeVar('T')

class G(Generic[T]):
    pass

X = G[int]
```
